title: Gumball Music Pack
description: Replaces records with songs from The Amazing and Wonderfully Weird World of Gumball
body:
So I'm a huge Gumball fan, and a while back I made a custom pack for Bedrock that replaced the music discs with songs from the show. And as it's the show's 15th anniversary and Season 7 has been released, I decided to update and release it, as well as making a Java port for it.

There's 21 tracks in total for 26.2 Snapshot 7. I tried to get as much variety as I could whilst also getting all the main ones.

The full track list is as follows:

Main Theme (Extended by CLOVER, https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oK8jcNqc8Xw)

Alligators Off This Train

You Gotta Think Big (Extended by Me)

What He Thinks About Us

My Little Ones

Make the Most of It

Life Can Make You Smile

What is Love?

I'm on My Way

Weird Like You and Me

Without You (Extended by Elmore Stream It, https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nN9rxTtmr8E)

Goodbye

I am Free

My Lonely Backside and I

Life is Beautiful

If It's Too Hard to Forgive

All Haill All Hallow's Eve

Hashtag Trending (Extended by Clover Network https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RejS2Q5zhqk)

Ending Theme

Leap Before I Look

Just Because You Grow More, Doesn't Mean You Know More

Out of Sync
